AN ACT to amend the election law, in relation to requiring the county seat in

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6349

SPONSOR: HELMING
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the election law, in relation to requiring the county
seat in Wayne county to have at least one polling place designated for
early voting

 
PURPOSE:

Requires the county seat in Wayne County to have at least one polling
place designated for early voting.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section one of this bill amends paragraph (a) of subdivision 2 of
section 8-600 of the Election Law to provide that the county seat of
Wayne County may be a designated as an early polling site for the
purposes of such law. (Amends Chapter 74 of 2021).

Section two is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Chapter 74 of the laws of 2021 requires each county board of elections
to include at least one early voting site in the municipality with the
highest population in such county based on the latest federal decennial
census. Chapter 74 also provides that, to the extent practicable, if
such municipality has public transportation routes, such polling place
shall be situated along such transportation routes.

In the case of Wayne County, the Town of Arcadia, which is the largest
municipality in Wayne County, is located in close proximity (less than
1/10 of a mile) to the county seat, Lyons. The Wayne County seat, Lyons,
is also served by public transportation routes.  Additionally, having
this polling site located in the Wayne County Office Building along with
the Board of Elections is both beneficial for voters and instrumental in
the efficient use of time, money and resources. Thus, under these
special circumstances, it is appropriate to authorize Wayne County to
designate the county seat, Lyons, as an early voting site in compliance
with Chapter 74.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill. (Similar bill has passed the Senate in 2021 - S.1310)

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the State.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.
